fields.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against champions reduce ''Missile Barrage's'' remaining recharge time by {{pp|2 to 6 for 11|0 to 100|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|key1=%}} seconds.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within the area.
fields.description3: '''Corki''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Missile Barrage'' charge, up to a maximum of 4. He gains 2 charges upon learning the ability and maximum charges upon [[death|respawning]].
fields.description4: Every third missile '''Corki''' fires is a ''{{ai|Big One|Corki}}'', dealing 100% increased damage as well as gaining increased range and explosion radius.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
